_comment: Salesforce-HOSTED Data 360 MCP server (no local process). Cursor form: url + auth.CLIENT_ID (the External Client App Consumer Key). Auth is per-user OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, handled interactively by the client — NO secret in this file. Sandbox URL shown; use the /data/ (non-sandbox) path for production. See setup/02-auth-setup.md and 03-connect-claude.md.
